aboutGame.title: What is Shape of Dreams?
paragraphs: Shape of Dreams is a top-down, MOBA-style co-op action roguelite from developer Lizard Smoothie and publisher NEOWIZ. You drop into shifting dream worlds as one of eight Travelers, draft Memories and Essences between fights, and rebuild your power from scratch every run. Combat is fast hack-and-slash, but the real skill is the draft: every upgrade you take narrows or widens the build you can finish.

Shape of Dreams launched on September 10, 2025 for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2, and supports up to four players in online co-op. The game ships with 8 Travelers, 150+ Memories & Essences, 9 Lucid Dreams, and 8 worlds, so there is always another archetype to learn. Our wiki covers the roster, builds, mechanics, bosses, and co-op strategies for every run.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Shape of Dreams.

items.question: What is Shape of Dreams?
items.answer: Shape of Dreams is a top-down co-op action roguelite from Lizard Smoothie and NEOWIZ. You play as one of eight Travelers, draft Memories and Essences between fights, and rebuild your build from scratch every run across shifting dream worlds.

items.question: Is Shape of Dreams playable in co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Shape of Dreams supports up to four players in online co-op, and enemy difficulty scales with the size of your party. Assign frontline, damage, support, and flex roles so the team never starves itself of crowd control.

items.question: How many Travelers are in Shape of Dreams?
items.answer: Shape of Dreams ships with eight Travelers, each with a unique kit that shapes which Memories and Essences scale for your run. Archetypes range from melee bruisers and assassins to ranged casters and support picks.

items.question: Does Shape of Dreams have codes?
items.answer: There are currently no active Shape of Dreams codes. If a redemption system is added, official Shape of Dreams codes would be announced first on the Steam news hub and the official Discord.

items.question: What are Memories and Essences in Shape of Dreams?
items.answer: Memories are the run-scoped ability layer of a Shape of Dreams build, and combining two of them can create a stronger result. Essences are the slotted passives that anchor your archetype, so every Essence you take is a trade against future flexibility.

items.question: Which platforms is Shape of Dreams on?
items.answer: Shape of Dreams launched on September 10, 2025 for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2, and it supports up to four players in online co-op.
